# Ransack

> Object-based searching for Active Record

## Full Documentation

- [Complete documentation](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/llms-full.txt): All canonical pages in one Markdown document.

## Overview

- [Ransack](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/): Object-based searching for Active Record. Add search forms and sortable columns to a Rails application with plain Ruby and ERB.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/): Add Ransack to a Rails application, and the Ruby, Rails and database versions it supports.
- [Simple mode](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/simple-mode/): Search from a controller and a form with search_form_for, sort_link and the default options.
- [Authorization](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/authorization/): Allowlist the attributes, associations, scopes and sorts a search may use, in the model or with strong parameters.
- [Advanced mode](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/advanced-mode/): Build nested condition groups with combinators for searches simple mode cannot express.
- [Using predicates](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/using-predicates/): How eq, cont, in, null and the other predicates turn a parameter into SQL.
- [Search matchers](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/search-matches/): Every predicate Ransack provides, with case sensitivity, wildcards, enums and attribute types.
- [Sorting](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/sorting/): Sort in the view and the controller, on associations, and what happens to unknown sorts.
- [Configuration](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/configuration/): Global options: SQL dialect, whitespace, blank values, the null sentinel, NULL ordering and the search key.
- [Upgrading](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/upgrading/): What changes between major and minor versions of Ransack, and what to do about it.

## Going further

- [Associations](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/associations/): Search through has_many and belongs_to associations, and relations that already have joins.
- [Ransackers](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/ransackers/): Define custom searchable attributes with Arel: dates, concatenated fields, Postgres columns and more.
- [Aliases](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/aliases/): Give long attribute paths short names with ransack_alias, for searching and sorting.
- [Scopes](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/scopes/): Use allowlisted scopes and class methods as search conditions, and how they handle false.
- [Custom predicates](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/custom-predicates/): Add your own predicates with Ransack.configure and add_predicate.
- [Merging searches](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/merging-searches/): Combine two searches into one relation.
- [Form customisation](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/form-customisation/): Build search forms by hand, with SimpleForm, or with custom labels and fields.
- [i18n](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/i18n/): Translate predicates and attributes, and search Globalize-translated attributes.
- [Polymorphic searches](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/polymorphic-search/): Search through a polymorphic belongs_to by naming the type.
- [PostgreSQL searches](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/searching-postgres/): Search PostgreSQL array and JSONB columns.
- [Acts-as-taggable-on](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/acts-as-taggable-on/): Search tags from acts-as-taggable-on, exactly, in combination, or by substring.
- [CSV export](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/exporting-to-csv/): Export the results of a search as CSV.
- [Saving queries](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/saving-queries/): Remember a user's search between requests.
- [Other notes](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/going-further/other-notes/): DISTINCT selects, Action Text, encrypted attributes, unknown conditions and OR grouping.

## Project

- [Community and support](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/community/): Where to ask questions, report bugs and security issues, and how to support Ransack.
- [How Ransack is built](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/architecture/): The pieces of Ransack and where it depends on Active Record's internals.
- [Documentation](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/documentation/): Build and preview this site locally, and add a page.
- [Versions and releases](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/release_process/): Semantic versioning and how a Ransack release is cut and published.
- [External resources](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/external-guides/): Screencasts, related gems and blog posts about Ransack.
- [Wiki contributors](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/wiki-contributors/): The people who wrote the original Ransack wiki.
- [Ransack 3.0.0 announcement](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/ransack-3-0-0/): The 3.0.0 announcement.
